verses.sanskrit:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच।
              ततः श्रुत्वा हतं सङ्ख्ये कुम्भकर्णं सहानुगम्। प्रहस्तं च महेष्वासं धूम्राक्षं चातितेजसम्॥१॥
verses.english: Markandeya said : Then, hearing that the mighty bowman Prahasta, the highly-energetic Dhumraksha and Kumbhakarna together with his followers had been killed in battle, Ravana spoke to his heroic son Indrajita (thus), “O destroyer of foes, slay Rama together with Sugriva and Lakshmana.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रमिन्द्रजितं वीरं रावणः प्रत्यभाषत। जहि रामममित्रघ्न सुग्रीवं च सलक्ष्मणम्॥२॥
त्वया हि मम सत्पुत्र यशो दीप्तमुपार्जितम्। जित्वा वज्रधरं सङ्ख्ये सहस्राक्षं शचीपतिम्॥३॥
verses.english: O my dutiful son, by conquering the thousand-eyed wielder of the Vajra (thunderbolt), the husband of Sachi, in battle, you have acquired a blazing renown for me.

verses.sanskrit: अन्तर्हितः प्रकाशो वा दिव्यैर्दत्तवरैः शरैः। जहि शत्रूनमित्रघ्न मम शस्त्रभृतां वर॥४॥
verses.english: Remaining (either) invisible or visible, O slayer of foes, the best of those that wield weapon, kill my enemies by celestials weapons granted to you as boons.

verses.sanskrit: रामलक्ष्मणसुग्रीवाः शरस्पर्शं न तेऽनघ। समर्थाः प्रतिसोढुं च कुतस्तदनुयायिनः॥५॥
verses.english: O sinless one, not to speak of their followers, even Rama, Lakshmana and Sugriva cannot endure the touch of your weapons.

verses.sanskrit: अगता या प्रहस्तेन कुम्भकर्णेन चानघ। खरस्यापचितिः सङ्ख्ये तां गच्छ त्वं महाभुज॥६॥
verses.english: O sinless and mighty-armed one, bring to a (successful) termination the hostilities which even Prahasta and Kumbhakarna could not effect in battle.

verses.sanskrit: त्वमद्य निशितैर्बाणैर्हत्वा शत्रून् ससैनिकान्। प्रतिनन्दय मां पुत्र पुरा जित्वेव वासवम्॥७॥
verses.english: My son, destroying, today, my enemies together with their followers, increase my delight as you did before by conquering Vasava."

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्तः स तथेत्युक्त्वा रथमास्थाय दंशितः। प्रययाविन्द्रजिद्राजंस्तूर्णमायोधनं प्रति॥८॥
verses.english: O king, thus addressed (by his father), Indrajita replied “it shall be so" and donning his armour and riding on his car, he soon marched towards the battle-field.

verses.sanskrit: ततो विश्राव्य विस्पष्टं नाम राक्षसपुङ्गवः। आह्वयामास समरे लक्ष्मणं शुभलक्षणम्॥९॥
verses.english: Then that foremost of Rakshasas distinctly announcing his name, challenged Lakshmana bearing auspicious signs, to battle.

verses.sanskrit: तं लक्ष्मणोऽभ्यधावच्च प्रगृह्य सशरं धनुः। त्रासयंस्तलघोषेण सिंहः क्षुद्रमृगान् यथा॥१०॥
verses.english: (And) like a lion (pursuing) a fawn, Lakshmana taking up his bow together with arrows and terrifying his adversary by striking his arm with his palms, rushed towards him.

verses.sanskrit: तयोः समभवद्युद्धं सुमहज्जयगृद्धिनोः। दिव्यास्त्रविदुषोस्तीव्रमन्योन्यस्पर्थिनोस्तदा॥११॥
verses.english: Then, there ensued a terrible and mighty encounter between those two (warriors), desirous of overcoming each other, both skilled in celestials weapons and setting at defiance the prowess of each other.

verses.sanskrit: रावणिस्तु यदा नैवं विशेषयति सायकैः। ततो गुरुतरं यत्नमातिष्ठद्बलिनां वरः॥१२॥
verses.english: When the son of Ravana, the strongest of the strong, could not get the better of his adversary by his arrows, he began to make vigorous exertions.

verses.sanskrit: तत एनं महावेगैरर्दयामास तोमरैः। तानागतान् स चिच्छेद सौमित्रिर्निशितैः शरैः॥१३॥
verses.english: Then he (Indrajita) began to hurl violently at Lakshmana, many javelins. But the son of Sumitra severed them to pieces as they were coming up to him, with sharpened arrows.

verses.sanskrit: ते निकृत्ताः शरैस्तीक्ष्णैर्न्यपतन् धरणीतले। तमङ्गदो वालिसुतः श्रीमानुद्यम्य पादपम्॥१४॥
verses.english: (Thus) cut down by sharpened darts they fell down on earth. Then the renowned Angada, the son to Bali, uprooting a tree and coming up with great speed, struck him (Indrajita) on the head. (But) the mighty Indrajita 'nothing daunted at this, took up a lance (and) wished to hurl it at him. (But) Lakshmana severed that lance.

verses.sanskrit: अभिद्रुत्य महावेगस्ताडयामास मूर्धनि। तस्येन्द्रजिदसभ्रान्तः प्रासेनोरसि वीर्यवान्॥१५॥
प्रहर्तुमैच्छत तं चास्य प्रासं चिच्छेद लक्ष्मणः। तमभ्याशगतं वीरमङ्गदं रावणात्मजः॥१६॥
गदयाऽताडयत् सव्ये पार्श्वे वानरपुङ्गवम्। तमचिन्त्यप्रहारं स बलवान् वालिनः सुतः॥१७॥
verses.english: (Then) the son of Ravana, (seeing) the heroic Angada stand close to him, struck on the left side of the foremost of monkeys with a mace.

verses.sanskrit: ससर्जेन्द्रजितः क्रोधाच्छालस्कन्धं तथाऽङ्गदः। सोऽङ्गदेन रुषोत्सृष्टो वधायेन्द्रजितस्तरुः॥१८॥
verses.english: Disregarding that stroke, the mighty son of Bali, Angada, wrathfully hurled a Sala stem at Indrajita.

verses.sanskrit: जघानेन्द्रजितः पार्थ रथं साश्वं ससारथिम्। ततो हताश्वात् प्रस्कन्द्य रथात् स हतसारथिः॥१९॥
verses.english: And that tree, hurled wrathfully by Angada for killing Indrajita, O Partha, destroyed his car together with the charioteer and horses.
verses.bhavadeepa: ससर्ज उत्सृष्टवान् । शालस्कन्धं महास्कन्धं तरुम् ॥१८॥ तान् हरीन्। तौ च रामलक्ष्मणौ ।

verses.sanskrit: तत्रैवान्तर्दधे राजन् मायया रावणात्मजः। अन्तर्हितं विदित्वा तं बहुमायं च राक्षसम्॥२०॥
verses.english: His horses and driver being slain, he jumped down from the car; and O king, resorting to his power of illusion, the son of Ravana vanished at that very spot.

verses.sanskrit: रामस्तं देशमागम्य तत् सैन्यं पर्यरक्षत। स राममुद्दिश्य शरैस्ततो दत्तवरैस्तदा॥२१॥
verses.english: Knowing that the Rakshasa capable of spreading various illusions, had disappeared, Rama coming up to that place (where the battle was raging) began to carefully protect his army.

verses.sanskrit: विव्याध सर्वगात्रेषु लक्ष्मणं च महाबलम्। तमदृश्यं शरैः शूरौ माययाऽन्तर्हितं तदा॥२२॥
verses.english: He (Indrajita), then, aiming at Rama and the highly-powerful Lakshmana began to pierce them, with arrows obtained as boons, all over their bodies.

verses.sanskrit: योधयामासतुरुभौ रावणिं रामलक्ष्मणौ। स रुषा सर्वगात्रेषु तयोः पुरुषसिंहयोः॥२३॥
verses.english: Then both the heroic Rama and Lakshmana, began to fight the son of Ravana, who remained invisible by his powers of illusion, by means of arrows.

verses.sanskrit: व्यसृजत् सायकान् भूयः शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः। तमदृश्यं विचिन्वन्तः सृजन्तमनिशं शरान्॥२४॥
verses.english: But Indrajita discharged at the bodies of those lions among men, incessant showers of arrows by hundreds and thousands.

verses.sanskrit: हरयो विविशुर्व्योम प्रगृह्य महतीः शिलाः। तांश्च तौ चाप्यदृश्यः स शरैर्विव्याध राक्षसः॥२५॥
verses.english: Seeing that he (Indrajita) remaining invisible, poured down showers of arrows, the monkeys taking up huge stones entered into (every part of the) firmament.

verses.sanskrit: स भृशं ताडयामास रावणिर्मायया वृतः। तौ शरैराचितौ वीरौ भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ। पेततुर्गगनाद्भूमिं सूर्याचन्द्रमसाविव॥२६॥
verses.english: And the two brothers, the heroic Rama and Lakshmana, wounded all over with shafts fell down on earth, as if the sun and the moon had fallen from the firmament.
